Definition: Jehovah-Jireh, a symbolical name for Mount Moriah
BiblicalUsage: Jehovah-Jireh is two Hebrew words joined as one name, 'the LORD' and 'he will see', or 'he will provide'. In Genesis 22:14, And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovah-jireh.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Jehovah-Jireh is not only a name for a mountain; it is what God still does, providing where I can see no way.
